hypothesis: PROTEI DPI is substantially the same product as Russian TSPU/EcoFilter, merely rebranded for export or alternate customers.
headline: Public evidence points to two independently developed DPI product lines: RDP.RU EcoDPI/EcoFilter as the principal TSPU filtering stack, and NTC PROTEI's separate PROTEI_DPI product. Shared generic server components, standards, customers, or Russian telecom ecosystem links remain possible and do not change this verdict.

evidence_against_rebrand.finding: TSPU's main DPI/filtering component is publicly attributed to RDP.RU EcoFilter/EcoDPI, not PROTEI.
evidence_against_rebrand.detail: Current reporting and technical reconstructions identify RDP.RU as the DPI developer/supplier for TSPU, with EcoFilter/EcoDPI used for filtering and application recognition. RDP.RU EcoDPI trademark was filed in 2016 and registered in 2017.

evidence_against_rebrand.finding: PROTEI_DPI has a separate legal/software lineage.
evidence_against_rebrand.detail: PROTEI_DPI was independently entered in the Russian software registry in June 2017 under NTC PROTEI and later separately registered/certified. PROTEI describes the product as its own DPI platform and has independently deployed it in foreign operator networks such as Niger.

evidence_against_rebrand.finding: The two vendors were treated as separate competitors in pre-TSPU DPI testing.
evidence_against_rebrand.detail: 2018 reporting on tests of Russian traffic-filtering systems listed RDP.RU and NTC PROTEI as separate candidate vendors. PROTEI co-owner Anton Pinchuk confirmed the company had been invited/tested but said PROTEI withdrew from participation.

evidence_against_rebrand.finding: Known TSPU hardware/software composition differs from published PROTEI DPI composition.
evidence_against_rebrand.detail: TSPU technical reporting identifies EcoFilter/EcoDPI software from RDP.RU, with later hardware associated with Yadro Vegman servers plus separate bypass/switch components. PROTEI DPI certification describes its own server-based platform and product versioning. Similar x86/Intel/network-card components would be generic telecom hardware, not evidence of common product identity.

NTC PROTEI is a separately founded St Petersburg company with its own founders and product portfolio. RDP.RU is a distinct Moscow company that became controlled by Rostelecom structures and is publicly tied to the state TSPU deployment chain.

evidence_that_keeps_a_narrow_overlap_hyp: Both are Russian telecom DPI vendors operating in the same standards/ecosystem and can implement overlapping functions such as URL/domain filtering, traffic classification, policy enforcement and bandwidth control.
Both may use commodity server/NIC components or third-party hardware platforms; identical OEM components would not imply identical DPI software.
PROTEI and Rostelecom formed a separate 5G joint venture in 2024, showing ecosystem proximity, but this is not evidence that PROTEI supplied TSPU DPI.
A future component-level discovery could show shared libraries, protocol classifiers, OEM hardware, subcontracting or integration, without making the complete products identical.

important_2018_test.finding: RDP.RU and PROTEI were separately named among DPI/filtering vendors evaluated for Telegram-blocking technology. PROTEI reportedly declined participation. This strongly disfavors the idea that PROTEI was simply the same RDP/TSPU system under another label at that time.

current_best_model.tspu_filtering_stack: RDP.RU EcoFilter/EcoDPI + TSPU control/management infrastructure and supporting hardware
current_best_model.protei_stack: Independent PROTEI_DPI / PCEF traffic-management platform plus separate PROTEI/NEOS SORM products
current_best_model.cuba_implication: A PROTEI customer/vendor bridge on Cuba cannot be converted into TSPU deployment evidence merely because PROTEI_DPI and TSPU share filtering capabilities.

killer_tests_if_reopened: Compare firmware/package names, binaries, symbol strings, protocol signature databases or software hashes from PROTEI_DPI and EcoDPI/EcoFilter.
Search procurement/BOM documents for cross-supply or OEM relationships between NTC PROTEI and RDP.RU.
Compare management protocols, API paths, CLI syntax, configuration schema and telemetry formats.
Compare packet-level active-block fingerprints generated by known deployments of each product under controlled conditions.
Look for shared engineers, patents, code ownership transfers, sublicensing, subcontracting or source-code provenance.
Do not infer identity from identical server chassis, NICs, Intel CPUs, DPDK use, or generic DPI functionality.
epistemic_firewall: same Rostelecom relationship != same TSPU role
exported PROTEI DPI != exported TSPU unless a direct product/control-plane bridge is demonstrated
